items.name: Chill Up: Monday Madness and Phangan Calling
items.venue: Chill UP club, 114/2 Moo 1, Ban Tai main road, Koh Phangan
items.gmapsQuery: Chill UP club, Ban Tai, Koh Phangan
items.description: Free-entry bar and mini club on Ban Tai main road, Koh Phangan, open since 2015. Monday Madness plays progressive house, minimal and techno. Thursday Phangan Calling plays indie dance, tech house and techno (some editions are called Techno Rebellion). Music runs until 02:00. A good warm-up spot. Closed on Wednesdays.
items.recurrence: Mondays (Monday Madness) and Thursdays (Phangan Calling), music from about 20:00 or 21:00 to 02:00. Bar open 19:00-02:00, closed Wednesdays.
tips: Opposite Mini Big C, before Lavella Spa on the road to Haad Rin.
Start here, then go on to a later party. Chill Up closes at 02:00.
items.verification: Official site chillup.club (15 Oct 2026): Monday Madness on Mon, Phangan Calling on Thu, free entry, open 19:00-02:00, closed Wed. phangan.events lists Monday Madness every Monday to Mar 2027 (21:00-02:00) and Phangan Calling on 15 Oct (20:00-02:00). DJStrich lists Monday Madness on 11 and 18 Jan 2027 (20:00), Phangan Calling on 14 Jan 2027, and Techno Rebellion editions on 22 Oct, 26 Nov and 17 Dec 2026. Google Maps 'Chill UP club': 4.4 (509 reviews), with reviews from this week. Coords: Google listing, OSM and plus code agree within 6 m.

items.name: Eden Garden Saturday (Haad Yuan)
items.venue: Eden Garden, Haad Yuan Beach, Koh Phangan
items.coordSource: google-maps-listing (from the listing's own map link)+pluscode M3VG+89H+osm (within 46 m)
items.gmapsQuery: Eden Garden, Haad Yuan, Koh Phangan
items.description: Long-running free Saturday party on the rocks at Haad Yuan, a small beach north of Haad Rin. Mostly house and tech house, with some progressive and techno, from 21:00 until late Sunday morning. Go by taxi boat from Haad Rin or by 4x4 taxi truck from Ban Tai. Both run all night and leave when full.
items.recurrence: Every Saturday, 21:00 to late Sunday morning
tips: Taxi trucks leave from the 7-Eleven in Ban Tai. Taxi boats leave from Haad Rin beach. They run all night and go when full.
No videos, no drones, no shoes on the dance floor. Do not climb on the rocks.
Bring cash and a small torch. Keep your phone and power bank safe from water.
items.verification: phangan.events 'Eden Garden Saturday' series (updated 7 Oct 2026) lists every Saturday, including 9 and 16 Jan 2027, 21:00-12:00, free entry, with taxi boat and truck info and house rules. A lineup for 17 Oct 2026 was posted on 15 Oct. Google Maps 'Eden Garden' (the place in the listing's own map link): 4.5 (464 reviews), not marked closed. Coords: Google point = plus code (2 m); OSM node is 46 m away.

items.name: Unclave (Groovy Tunes minimal nights)
items.venue: Unclave, Ban Tai hills, Koh Phangan
items.gmapsQuery: Unclave Phangan, Ban Tai, Koh Phangan
items.description: Underground club in the jungle hills above Ban Tai, Koh Phangan (RA lists room for 500). Home of Groovy Tunes, a minimal and deep house party about every second Friday from 22:00 to sunrise. It books guests like Cosmjn and Direkt from Romania (30 Oct 2026). In high season other crews play on other nights.
items.recurrence: Groovy Tunes about every second Friday (2026 season: every two weeks from 24 Jul, all Fridays); other crews on other nights in high season
items.priceText: Groovy Tunes presale on Megatix: 400-600 THB (16 Oct 2026); 500-900 THB for the 30 Oct special.
tips: If the two-week pattern holds, Groovy Tunes falls on Fri 8 Jan 2027 (your arrival day) and next on about Fri 22 Jan (after your trip). Check @groovytunes__ in December.
Last season the New Year party moved the dates (10 Jan 2026 was a Saturday), so a date during your trip is possible.
Buy early on Megatix. The price goes up with each release.
items.verification: RA (GraphQL, 15 Oct 2026): Groovy Tunes on Fridays every two weeks since 24 Jul 2026 (2 Oct and 16 Oct, 22:00-07:00). Venue capacity 500, not marked closed. Megatix: 16 Oct presale 400/600 THB; 30 Oct 'Experiween w Cosmjn, Direkt' at 500/700/900 THB. Jan 2026 also had Izhevski (12 Jan) and Zorka x Hypnotica (15 and 21 Jan); KONTUR afters was on 8 Feb 2026, not in January. No Jan 2027 dates posted yet. Google Maps 'Unclave Phangan': 4.7 (61 reviews).

items.name: Waterfall Festival (Wednesdays)
items.venue: Waterfall Festival site, Ban Tai, Koh Phangan
items.gmapsQuery: Waterfall Festival, Ban Tai, Koh Phangan
items.description: Big jungle party next to a waterfall in Ban Tai, Koh Phangan, with five stages. The main stage plays house and melodic techno with lasers. Other stages play hip-hop, psytrance and afrobeat. Now it runs 2 days before and 2 days after each Full Moon Party. In Jan-Feb 2026 it also ran on Wednesdays. Very touristy.
items.recurrence: 2 days before and 2 days after each Full Moon Party, plus special nights; in Jan-Feb 2026 also most Wednesdays. 21:00 to sunrise.
items.priceText: Oct 2026: 1,100 THB early bird online, 1,300 online, 1,500 at the door (one beer included). VIP 2,500 online, 2,800 at the door.
tips: Wed 13 Jan 2027 is only expected. The January Full Moon Party is expected on Fri 22 Jan 2027, so the Full Moon dates fall after your trip. Check again in December.
Buy online early. It is cheaper than the door.
The festival has no taxi service. Shared taxis go from Thong Sala, Haad Rin and Srithanu.
items.verification: Official site API (waterfallpartykohphangan.com, 15 Oct 2026) lists only 25 and 29 Oct 2026. Instagram bio says '2 Days Before and After the full moon' and '5 stages'. phangan.events shows Wednesday parties on 14 and 21 Jan and every Wednesday in Feb 2026, Oct 2026 prices, and next dates on 11, 22 and 26 Nov 2026. No 2027 dates yet. The Jan 2027 Full Moon Party is projected for 22 Jan (not official). Google Maps 'Waterfall Festival': 4.1 (677 reviews).

items.name: Deep Sundays at Pangea Beach Bar (Koh Lanta)
items.venue: Pangea Beach Bar & Kitchen, Long Beach (Phra Ae), Koh Lanta
items.gmapsQuery: Pangeabar & kitchen, Long Beach, Koh Lanta
items.description: Beach bar on Long Beach, Koh Lanta, known for deep and minimal house since 2012. It booked Ian Pooley, Clive Henry and Nakadia in past years. In high season it runs 'Deep Sundays' from 18:00 with sunset DJ sets, last seen in March 2026. Small (about 300 people). Only worth it if you stay on Koh Lanta.
items.recurrence: Sundays in high season from 18:00 (seen 15 and 29 Mar 2026)
tips: Check facebook.com/pangeabeachbar before you go. The 2027 season is not announced.
On Google Maps it is called 'Pangeabar & kitchen'. It is closed on Wednesdays.
Koh Lanta is a ferry trip from Phuket. Plan at least one night there.
items.verification: RA (GraphQL): Deep Sundays on 15 Mar 2026 (18:00-02:00) and 29 Mar 2026 (18:00-00:00). Past nights with Ian Pooley (2018), Clive Henry (2019) and Nakadia (2020); 6th anniversary in Feb 2018; capacity 300. Google Maps 'Pangeabar & kitchen' is open, 4.4 (374 reviews), Sun 16:00-24:00, Wed closed. The Facebook page (now 'Pangea Beach Bar & Kitchen') works. Coords: Wikidata = given point; Google pin 43 m away, OSM 64 m. No Jan 2027 dates yet.
